articles.summary: The Board of Directors of First Financial Bank, a subsidiary of First Financial Bankshares, Inc. (NASDAQ: FFIN), has announced its plan to open a new full-service branch in Bee Cave, Texas. This new branch, located at 12101 Bee Caves Rd., is set to open in late October and expands the Company's presence into Central Texas and the greater Austin area while reinforcing its long-term commitment to serving communities across Texas. First Financial has maintained a mortgage loan production office in Bee Cave since 2020. The new full-service branch marks the next step in the Bank's commitment to Central Texas, allowing First Financial to deepen existing relationships while expanding its reach to serve individuals, families and businesses across the greater Austin market. articles.title: FIRST FINANCIAL BANK TO OPEN FIRST FULL-SERVICE BRANCH IN AUSTIN AREA WITH NEW BEE CAVE BRANCH
